title: Understanding the Principal Component Matrix
text: The principal component matrix $P$ is derived from the original data matrix. It has the same number of rows as the original data matrix, which corresponds to the number of observations or samples.

title: Number of Rows in the Original Data
text: The original data matrix has $$1000$$ rows, as it represents the data collected from $$1000$$ visitors.
